Hi @Berk-Unsal, I’d like to contribute to this issue. I can work on creating GitHub issue forms for reproducible planning bugs and scoped feature/research proposals, following the repository’s existing conventions.

Could you please assign this issue to me? I’ll ensure the forms capture the required reproduction details and proposal scope, use valid GitHub issue-form YAML and existing labels, and clearly warn contributors not to share secrets, private campaign locations, or raw route data. I’ll also validate the forms against the acceptance criteria.

Thank you for the opportunity to contribute to A.T.O.M!

Thanks for picking this up, I’ve assigned the issue to you. The scope you described matches what I had in mind. Please keep it limited to the issue forms/config and the existing acceptance criteria; no CI or workflow automation is needed. Looking forward to the PR.

Reviewed: both issue forms pass YAML and structural checks, use existing labels, and meet the intended scope. No blocking findings. The pre-existing documentation CI failure on main will be fixed separately.

hi @Berk-Unsal !
This issue has been completed and merged through PR #92. The changes include structured bug report and feature/research proposal forms, issue template configuration to disable blank issues, and the necessary `.gitignore` exceptions. All three YAML files were validated successfully.

Thank you for assigning this issue. please close it as completed.
